categories.label: Music
categories.descHtml: I have been composing and making music since my student days.</br>Starting with band activities, I have moved on to DTM production and am now experimenting with AI.

sections.descHtml: An animal dance song project using AI generation.</br>Songs are made with Suno AI, and videos are edited from the generated assets using Premiere, Remotion, and a game engine.

items.title: Hammerhead Shark Song
items.description: An energetic dance song about a hammerhead shark. The video is made with Premiere.

items.title: The Traveling Crab
items.description: A piece created using Unreal Engine and Houdini. It cost me my summer vacation.

items.title: Crybaby Chameleon
items.description: A slightly bittersweet song about a chameleon. The video is made with Remotion.
